frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Calendrier, disponibilites et evenements
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Afficher et manipuler les calendriers role par role avec evenements, invitations, rappels et disponibilites.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Video session join URL can be mocked until video-session-service phase.
Financial calendar events can be hidden or mocked until finance-credit-service phase.

frontTests.item: User filters by event type and person.
Invitee accepts an event and visual state changes.

apiGatewayImpact.item: Keep slashless and trailing slash variants coherent.

definitionOfDone.item: Calendar is usable from profile/dashboard placeholders.
Future services can attach events without changing the core UI.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
